name: After § 28
title: REPORT on the housing crisis in the European Union with the aim of proposing solutions for decent, sustainable and affordable housing
part_text: 28a. Stresses that housing support measures should remain targeted and temporary where appropriate, in accordance with national housing systems; encourages prioritisation of measures facilitating access to ownership through proportionate instruments supporting first-time buyers and household asset formation; highlights the importance of fiscal sustainability and regular evaluation of support schemes, including their effects on small property owners; encourages multi-generational housing models and the better utilisation of underused housing stock; calls on Member States to strengthen safeguards against abuse, including measures addressing persistent non-payment of rent, illegal occupation and misuse of social housing; calls for improved transparency and anti-fraud mechanisms within social housing allocation systems;
